messages.content: Freddie and his team are collecting blankets for three days to be donated to the Children Shelter Organization. There are 15 people on the team. On the first day, each of them gave 2 blankets. On the second day, they tripled the number they collected on the first day by asking door-to-door. On the last day, they set up boxes at schools and got a total of 22 blankets. How many blankets did they collect for the three days for donation?

On the first day, each of the 15 team members gave 2 blankets. So, the total number of blankets collected on the first day is:
15 members * 2 blankets/member = 30 blankets

On the second day, they tripled the number collected on the first day. So, the total number of blankets collected on the second day is:
30 blankets * 3 = 90 blankets

On the last day, they collected 22 blankets.

To find the total number of blankets collected over the three days, we add the blankets from each day:
30 blankets (first day) + 90 blankets (second day) + 22 blankets (last day) = 142 blankets

FINAL: 142
